items.title: Claude Opus 5
items.author: alvis
items.summary_zh: Claude Opus 5是Anthropic最新发布的大型语言模型，据称在推理、代码生成和多轮对话能力上实现了显著飞跃。相比前代，它更擅长处理长上下文和复杂指令，同时保持了较高的安全性。对于需要强大AI助手进行编程、写作及分析的开发者与研究者来说，这代表了一项重要的生产力提升工具。
items.summary_en: Claude Opus 5 is Anthropic's latest large language model, boasting major improvements in reasoning, code generation, and multi-turn conversation. It handles longer contexts and complex instructions more adeptly while maintaining strong safety guardrails. For developers and researchers seeking a powerful AI assistant for coding, writing, and analysis, this release marks a significant leap in productivity.

items.title: Writing by hand is good for your brain
items.author: dwwoelfel
items.summary_zh: 最新的神经科学研究再次证实，手写比打字更能激活大脑中负责学习和记忆的区域。当人们用笔在纸上写字时，手部精细动作与视觉、空间感知的协同作用能加深对信息的处理，从而提升理解和长期记忆。对于学生、创意工作者以及任何希望提高学习效率的人来说，暂时放下键盘、拿起纸笔可能是一种简单而有效的认知训练。
items.summary_en: Recent neuroscience research reaffirms that handwriting engages the brain's learning and memory centers far more deeply than typing. The coordinated fine motor movements, visual feedback, and spatial awareness involved in putting pen to paper enhance information processing, leading to better comprehension and long-term retention. For students, creatives, and anyone seeking to learn more effectively, this suggests that swapping the keyboard for a notebook now and then is a simple yet powerful cognitive boost.

items.title: Startup founders urge U.S. government not to shut off Chinese open weight AI
items.author: theanonymousone
items.summary_zh: 一群创业公司的创始人联合向美国政府发出呼吁，请求不要切断中国开源AI模型的访问渠道。他们认为，中国团队开发的开放权重模型（如Qwen、Llama的中国衍生版）为全球AI生态注入了竞争与多样性，阻断它们将损害技术创新，并迫使全球开发者依赖少数封闭平台。这一呼声凸显了AI开源社区对地缘政治干预的真实忧虑。
items.summary_en: A group of startup founders has urged the U.S. government not to block access to Chinese open-weight AI models, arguing that models like Qwen and derivative Llama variants contribute crucial competition and diversity to the global AI ecosystem. They warn that cutting off these models would stifle innovation and force developers towards a handful of closed platforms. The plea underscores growing anxiety within the open-source community over geopolitical tensions threatening cross-border AI collaboration.

items.title: Android may soon restrict on-device ADB
items.author: shscs911
items.summary_zh: 有消息称Android可能很快会限制设备上的ADB（Android调试桥）功能。这一变化主要是出于安全考虑，因为恶意应用常利用ADB权限进行静默安装或数据窃取。但限制也会影响开发者和高级用户，他们依赖本地ADB进行快速调试和自动化测试。如果你经常通过USB或无线ADB连接设备进行开发，需要留意后续的Android版本是否会收紧这一功能。
items.summary_en: Reports suggest Android may soon restrict on-device ADB access to improve security, as malicious apps often abuse ADB permissions for silent installations or data theft. However, this change could impact developers and power users who rely on local ADB for convenient debugging and automation. If you frequently use ADB over USB or Wi-Fi for development, keep an eye on upcoming Android releases — they might require alternative methods like remote debugging through authorized hosts.

items.title: If coding has been solved, why does software keep getting worse?
items.author: pchm
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章挑战了“AI已经解决了编程问题”的流行叙事，反问：如果编码真的被“解决”了，为什么软件质量反而越来越差？作者指出，AI代码助手虽然能快速生成大量代码，但缺乏对软件架构、可维护性和长期可靠性的理解，导致技术债务积累。而且，糟糕的需求和设计决策才是软件变坏的根源，而这些靠自动补全根本无法解决。对于开发者而言，这提醒我们不要盲目迷信AI，而应坚持良好的工程实践。
items.summary_en: This article pushes back against the claim that AI has solved coding, asking why software keeps getting worse if that were true. The author argues that AI code assistants generate plenty of code quickly but lack understanding of architecture, maintainability, and long-term reliability, leading to technical debt. Worse, bad requirements and design decisions — not the act of writing code — are the real cause of software degradation, and autocomplete won't fix that. Developers are reminded to not blindly trust AI and to uphold good engineering practices.

items.title: Kill The Cookie Banner
items.author: rapnie
items.summary_zh: Kill The Cookie Banner是一款浏览器扩展，它能自动处理恼人的Cookie同意弹窗，让用户彻底摆脱每次访问新网站时都要手动点击或关闭横幅的烦恼。这个工具通过预设规则自动拒绝不必要的追踪请求，不仅提升了网页浏览的流畅度，还在无形中保护了用户隐私。对于那些被无数Cookie通知折磨的用户来说，这无疑是个救星。
items.summary_en: Kill The Cookie Banner is a browser extension that automatically handles those annoying cookie consent pop-ups, freeing users from the constant need to manually click or dismiss banners on every new website. By preemptively rejecting unnecessary tracking requests through preset rules, it not only makes web browsing smoother but also silently bolsters user privacy. For anyone who has ever been annoyed by the endless stream of cookie notifications, this tool is a welcome relief.

items.title: My security camera shipped a GitHub admin token in its login page
items.author: hhh
items.summary_zh: 一名用户发现其购买的安防摄像头在登录页面的HTML源码中硬编码了一个GitHub管理员的访问令牌。这意味着任何能查看页面源码的人都有可能直接接管与该令牌关联的GitHub账户。这一事件揭示了物联网设备在供应链安全和固件开发流程中的严重漏洞，敲响了智能家居设备厂商必须加强安全审计的警钟。
items.summary_en: A user discovered that their security camera had a GitHub admin access token hard-coded in the login page's HTML source code, meaning anyone who could view the page source potentially had the ability to take over the associated GitHub account. This incident highlights a severe supply chain and firmware development flaw in IoT devices, serving as a stark warning for smart home manufacturers to ramp up security audits and avoid shipping such dangerous credentials.

For designers, artists, and anyone exploring AI-powered visual creation, Flux 3 represents a clear step forward.

This cautionary tale offers valuable lessons for anyone considering moving away from major platforms in favor of fully open alternatives.

Unlike general-purpose LLMs, Kronos has been trained on vast amounts of financial texts and historical data, mastering domain-specific terms and logic. It assists quantitative trading, risk management, and investment research. For quantitative analysts and institutional investors, Kronos promises to be a powerful tool for interpreting market signals and generating trading strategies.

items.author: asgeirtj
items.summary_zh: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks 是一个 GitHub 项目，它收集了 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 多个大模型的系统提示词，包括 Claude Fable 5、Opus 4.8、ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking 等。这些提示词揭示了模型背后如何被引导、如何设定角色和限制，对 AI 研究者和开发者理解模型行为非常有价值。它引发了关于提示工程和模型安全边界的讨论，也是窥探顶级 AI 内部设计的一个窗口。
items.summary_en: This GitHub repository compiles leaked system prompts from popular AI models like Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Opus 4.8, as well as OpenAI's ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking and GPT 5.5 Instant. By exposing the hidden instructions that shape how these models behave, it offers rare insight into prompt engineering, safety guardrails, and role-setting techniques. AI researchers and developers can learn how top models are orchestrated, but the leak also raises important questions about access control and intellectual property in the generative AI race.

items.title: Pushary
items.description: Approve AI requests from your lock screen
items.summary_zh: Pushary是一款创新的工具，让你直接从手机锁屏上批准AI发出的请求，无需解锁设备。这种设计大幅提升了效率，特别适合那些频繁需要授权AI代理访问数据或执行操作的场景，比如自动化工作流或智能家居控制。对于依赖AI助手的用户来说，Pushary简化了交互流程，将审批过程变得像查看通知一样快速便捷，既安全又省时。
items.summary_en: Pushary is an innovative app that lets you approve AI requests directly from your lock screen without unlocking your phone. It streamlines the interaction with AI agents, allowing for quick authorization of actions like data access or task execution. This is especially useful for users who rely on automated workflows or smart home controls, where fast approvals are needed. By turning the approval process into a simple lock-screen notification, Pushary enhances both security and efficiency, making AI interactions feel more natural and less intrusive.

items.title: Fluree AI
items.description: Give every AI agent trusted context
items.summary_zh: Fluree AI致力于为每个AI代理提供可信的上下文数据，确保人工智能决策基于可靠和经过验证的信息源。在AI应用日益普及的今天，模型幻觉和错误数据是主要痛点。Fluree AI通过构建可信的数据基础，帮助开发者在构建智能代理时减少虚构信息，提升回答的准确性。对于企业级AI部署而言，它提供了一种机制来保证AI输出的可信度，特别适合金融、医疗等对数据准确性要求极高的领域。
items.summary_en: Fluree AI aims to give every AI agent trusted context by providing a reliable and verifiable data foundation. As AI agents become more common, ensuring they base their decisions on accurate information is crucial to avoiding hallucinations and errors. Fluree AI solves this by integrating trusted data sources directly into the AI pipeline, allowing developers to build agents that produce more trustworthy outputs. This is particularly valuable for enterprise applications in finance, healthcare, and legal sectors where data integrity is paramount. By grounding AI in verified context, Fluree AI enhances reliability and reduces risk.

items.title: The new Firecrawl /search
items.description: Our most accurate Search API for AI agents.
items.summary_zh: Firecrawl推出的全新/search API专为AI代理打造，号称目前最精准的网页搜索接口，能从互联网中提取结构化数据并返回可靠结果。它解决了AI应用在实时信息获取时常见的噪声和不可靠性问题，对构建智能助手和自动化工具的开发者至关重要。
items.summary_en: The new Firecrawl /search API is designed specifically for AI agents, offering what is claimed to be the most accurate search endpoint available. It extracts structured data from the web and returns clean, reliable results, solving the issues of noise and unreliability that often plague AI applications needing real-time information. This makes it essential for developers building intelligent assistants, automation tools, or any system that depends on fresh, precise web data.

items.title: HarnessRouter
items.description: Bring the world's best AI agents into your app, with one API
items.summary_zh: HarnessRouter提供了一个统一的API接口，让你能够将全球最优秀的AI代理无缝集成到自己的应用中。开发者无需分别对接各个AI平台，只需一次接入就能调用多种高性能代理，大大简化了开发流程。对于想要快速为自己的产品添加智能功能而非构建底层模型的团队来说，它是加速AI落地的理想桥梁。
items.summary_en: HarnessRouter offers a single API to integrate the world's best AI agents into your app. Developers no longer need to connect to multiple AI platforms individually; one integration unlocks access to various high-performance agents, vastly simplifying development. For teams looking to quickly add intelligence to their products without building foundational models, it is an ideal bridge to accelerate AI deployment.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从Cursor切换到Amazon Codex使用了半个多月，分享了两者的本质差异。Cursor让他第一次感受到AI编程的震撼，但Codex让他真正觉得AI不再只是辅助工具，而是一个能独立执行任务的超级Agent。作者认为Codex更接近下一阶段AI编程的形态，从对话式补全进化到主动式代理，对追求最前沿编程体验的开发者有重要参考价值。
items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Amazon Codex for over half a month, a developer shared their real experience of the fundamental differences. While Cursor first impressed them with AI-assisted coding, Codex felt like a true super agent that can independently execute tasks, not just an assistant. The author believes Codex represents the next phase of AI programming—evolving from conversational completion to proactive agency. This comparison is invaluable for developers seeking the cutting edge in AI-powered coding tools.

items.title: Kimi k3是真碉，但太不经用，也有拉跨点！
items.description: K3 已测，确实强，但要命的是配额太少了！ 一天不到，一周的配额已经烧完了，大概就生成了 5 个测试页面！ 从五个例子中，可以知道，有些确实很强，有些呢又差点意思，有些比较糟糕。 我不是那种收钱办事儿
items.summary_zh: Kimi 的 K3 模型实测表现确实强悍，但致命缺陷是配额太少，一周的额度在一天内就用完了，只生成了五个测试页面。从这几个例子看，有的生成效果很棒，有的却不尽如人意，甚至有些糟糕。作者强调自己并非收钱办事，而是真实体验，这让 K3 的实际可用性打了折扣。
items.summary_en: The author tested Kimi's K3 model and found it genuinely powerful, but the critical issue is its extremely limited quota. A week's worth of quota was exhausted in just one day, allowing only five test page generations. Among the examples, some results were impressive while others were disappointing or even poor. The author stresses this is an unbiased review, highlighting that K3, despite its strength, suffers from severe availability constraints that undermine its practical use.

items.title: 小程序上线半年我赚了多少钱？
items.description: 1. 开发历程 时间过得真快，转眼间福猪记账小程序上线已经有半年时间了，从v1.0.0 版本做到了 v1.6.1 版本。今天整理了开发日志，真的不敢相信自己在工作之余能够把它做出来并上线。 2.用户积
items.summary_zh: 一位独立开发者分享了他业余开发的记账小程序“福猪记账”上线半年来的真实收入与运营数据。从v1.0.0迭代到v1.6.1，他记录了开发日志、用户增长曲线和盈利情况。这篇文章不仅展示了个人开发者利用业余时间做产品的可能性，也提供了从零到一、从技术到商业的完整复盘，特别适合想试试副业的程序员参考。
items.summary_en: An indie developer shared the real revenue and operational data of his expense tracking mini-program called 'Fuzhu' over six months since launch. He iterated from v1.0.0 to v1.6.1, documenting development logs, user growth, and profitability. This article demonstrates the possibility of building a product in spare time, offering a complete postmortem from coding to business. It’s especially useful for programmers exploring side projects.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了在AI能写出80%代码的背景下，技术面试如何从考察基础原理转向考察程序员的独特价值。面试官默认你熟悉AI工具，他们更看重问题拆解、业务理解、架构思维和人机协作能力，提醒开发者要聚焦AI无法替代的核心竞争力。
items.summary_en: The article explores how technical interviews have transformed as AI now writes 80% of the code. Interviewers assume proficiency with AI tools and instead evaluate skills that make developers irreplaceable: problem decomposition, business understanding, architectural thinking, and effective human-AI collaboration. It cautions against over-reliance on AI-generated code and urges developers to cultivate uniquely human competencies for long-term career relevance.

items.title: 最近公司烧token比招员工还贵，老板干懵了...
items.description: 如题。 这真的没在开玩笑。 这也是最近不少公司，在大力、甚至全面拥抱 AI 之后所发出的切实吐槽。 一个月前，Uber 的 CTO 曾对外透露，公司自部署 CC 以来，内部有超 9 成的工程师在高频率
items.summary_zh: 这不是段子，是真实发生在许多公司里的窘境。随着全面拥抱AI，员工高频调用大模型API，公司的token消耗费用竟然超过了招聘新员工的成本。Uber的CTO曾透露，内部有超过九成的工程师在频繁使用AI服务。老板们面对账单直呼头疼：本来是降本增效的AI，怎么成了新的烧钱黑洞？
items.summary_en: This isn't a joke—it's a real dilemma many companies are facing. After wholeheartedly adopting AI, their token usage costs have actually surpassed the expense of hiring new employees. Uber's CTO revealed that over 90% of their engineers are using AI services heavily. Bosses are staring at the bills in shock: the technology that was supposed to reduce costs and boost efficiency has instead become a new money-burning black hole.

items.title: 写给年轻程序员的几点建议-2
items.description: 现在互联网红利已经消失了，深知年轻程序员的不易，下面就浅薄地谈几点建议。中国人口基数比较大，要培养自己的 商业嗅觉。你能卖爆一个商品，就能获得巨大的财富。微信公众号如果能写出 几万 浏览量的文章，就有
items.summary_zh: 作者针对互联网红利消退的现状，向年轻程序员提出培养商业嗅觉和写作能力的建议。他认为在中国庞大的人口基数下，能卖爆一个商品或写出高阅读量的公众号文章就能获得巨大财富。文章强调技术之外的市场认知和内容表达能力同样重要，适合处于职业早期的程序员思考如何拓宽收入来源。
items.summary_en: The author offers advice for young programmers in the post-internet-bonus era, emphasizing the need to develop business acumen and writing skills. Given China's huge population, successfully selling a product or writing a viral WeChat article can bring significant wealth. The article argues that market insight and content communication are as crucial as technical skills, making it relevant for early-career programmers looking to diversify their income streams.

items.title: 三年了，为什么 AI 应用还没爆发？
items.description: 最近meta讲了个算力过剩的鬼故事，AI 股市应声暴跌，大家都很焦虑。 都在问这场 AI 游戏还能不能继续，AI 应用到底什么时候爆发，AI的抖音微信小红书什么时候才出现，AI会不会重蹈 2000 年
items.summary_zh: Meta 提出算力过剩观点后 AI 股市应声下跌，引发行业焦虑。文章反思 AI 应用三年未爆发的原因：基础设施投入巨大但 killer app 缺失，用户对 ChatGPT 等工具的新鲜感消退，而企业级落地面临成本和安全挑战。作者认为 AI 不会重蹈互联网泡沫，但需要找到像抖音微信那样的超级场景才能引爆下一波增长。
items.summary_en: When Meta suggested there was too much computing capacity, AI stocks tumbled, revealing deep anxiety in the industry. This article reflects on why AI applications haven't exploded after three years: massive infrastructure spending without a killer app, declining novelty of chatbots like ChatGPT, and enterprise deployment hurdles around cost and security. The author argues it's not a repeat of the 2000 dot-com bubble, but AI needs its own TikTok or WeChat moment to trigger the next growth wave. It's a sobering reality check for the industry.

items.title: 2026编程圈很火的10个Skills
items.description: 前言 最近编程圈最火的一个词，非 Skills 莫属。 不是指程序员的技术能力，而是指 AI 编程助手的“技能包” 。 一套让 AI 从“随缘写代码”变成“按流程交付”的标准化工作流模块。 今天这篇文
items.summary_zh: 2026 年编程圈热议的 10 个 Skills 并非指程序员的技术能力，而是 AI 编程助手的“技能包”——一套标准化工作流模块，让 AI 从随缘写代码变为按流程交付。这些技能包覆盖代码审查、测试生成、文档编写等环节，旨在提升开发效率和代码质量。对正在探索 AI 辅助编程的团队和个人开发者而言，掌握这些技能包将成为提高生产力的关键。
items.summary_en: The 10 hottest Skills in programming circles for 2026 refer not to developers' own abilities but to standardized workflow modules for AI coding assistants. These skill packages transform AI from random code generation to structured delivery, covering code review, test generation, documentation, and more. For teams and individual developers exploring AI-assisted programming, mastering these skills is becoming essential for boosting productivity and code quality.

items.title: 01｜（前端转全栈）前端人第一次打开 Spring Boot 项目，应该先看哪里？
items.description: 开篇背景：为什么前端现在也要懂后端 先聊一点真实工作里的变化。以前很多团队会把岗位分得很清楚：前端只写页面、交互、组件和接口调用；后端只写接口、数据库、缓存和权限。前端同学遇到接口报错，就把 Netw
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章是‘前端转全栈’系列的开篇，专门为初次接触Spring Boot的前端开发者而写。作者从实际工作变化入手，解释了为什么现在前端也需要掌握后端知识，然后引导读者从项目结构、配置文件、启动类等关键入口点开始理解Spring Boot。对于希望突破前端边界、向全栈迈进的前端工程师来说，这是一份贴心的入门指南，能帮你少走弯路。
items.summary_en: This article is the first in the 'Frontend to Full-Stack' series, tailored for frontend developers new to Spring Boot. The author explains why frontend engineers now need backend knowledge, starting with real workplace changes, then guides readers to understand Spring Boot through key entry points like project structure, configuration files, and startup classes. For frontend engineers looking to expand into full-stack, this is a thoughtful primer that helps avoid common pitfalls.

items.title: 盘点 18 个 Kimi K3 外网爆火的案例，太令人惊艳了。
items.description: 这个周末可太热闹了。 因为 Kimi K3 的发布，外网对这个模型的讨论非常热烈。总结来讲： ① 总参数达到 2.8 万亿， 目前最大的开源模型，100 万上下文，原生支持视觉理解。
items.summary_zh: 最近Kimi K3的发布引爆了外网讨论，这款开源模型总参数高达2.8万亿，成为目前最大的开源模型，支持百万级别的上下文长度，并且原生集成了视觉理解能力。文中盘点了18个惊艳案例，展示了它在长文档处理、多模态推理等场景的突破，让开发者们看到开源大模型的新高度。
items.summary_en: The release of Kimi K3 has ignited heated discussions abroad. This open-source model boasts an enormous 2.8 trillion total parameters, making it the largest open-source model to date. It supports a million-token context window and natively integrates visual understanding. The article highlights 18 impressive use cases that demonstrate its breakthroughs in long-document processing and multimodal reasoning, offering developers a glimpse into the new frontier of open-source large language models.

items.title: 为什么被称为「操控之王」的特斯拉赛道圈速成绩并不好？
items.summary_zh: 特斯拉被称为“操控之王”源于其在街道上的精准转向和敏捷反应，但赛道圈速表现平平。这是因为赛道驾驶对持续高性能和散热要求极高，特斯拉的电池组过重，热管理系统在激烈驾驶下容易过热衰减，导致动力输出受限。特斯拉的优势在于直线加速和智能电控，而非长时间高负荷的赛道竞技，这款车更适合日常驾驶而非专业刷圈。
items.summary_en: Tesla is famously called the 'handling king' for its sharp steering and agile feel on the road, yet its track lap times are often underwhelming. The contradiction stems from the battery pack's heavy weight and thermal management issues: under sustained high-performance driving, the system heats up and limits power output. Tesla shines in straight-line acceleration and daily handling, not in prolonged track sessions. In other words, it's a brilliant street car, not a purpose-built track star.

items.title: 2026 年菲尔兹奖会成为「最后一届没有 AI 的菲尔兹奖」吗？
items.summary_zh: 2026年菲尔兹奖可能成为最后一届没有AI参与的奖项，因为人工智能正在迅速改变数学研究方式。AI已能协助证明定理、发现数学规律，甚至独立提出猜想。传统菲尔兹奖强调人类智慧和个人贡献，若AI持续进步，未来评审将面临是否认可人机协作成果的争议，这届奖项可能成为人类独享荣誉时代的尾声。
items.summary_en: The 2026 Fields Medal might be the last one awarded without AI involvement. Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming mathematical research, helping prove theorems, discover patterns, and even formulate conjectures autonomously. The Fields Medal traditionally celebrates pure human ingenuity and individual achievement. As AI continues to advance, future committees will face tough questions about whether to credit human-AI collaborations. This upcoming award could mark the end of an era where human-only work is the standard.

items.title: 苏联在 60～80 年代为什么没有开发战机黑手党式的狗斗机？
items.summary_zh: 苏联在60至80年代没有开发类似西方“战斗机黑手党”倡导的狗斗机，主要是因为其空战理念不同。苏联空军强调超视距拦截和导弹攻击，认为近距格斗应避免。此外，苏联航空工业缺乏轻量化、高推重比的发动机技术，而偏向重型、高速度的截击机设计，如米格-25，这些飞机并不适合低速盘旋狗斗。
items.summary_en: The Soviet Union did not develop a dedicated dogfighter akin to the Western 'fighter mafia' concept in the 1960s-1980s due to differing air combat doctrines. Soviet strategy emphasized beyond-visual-range interception and missile attacks, aiming to avoid close-range engagements altogether. Additionally, their aviation industry lacked lightweight, high-thrust-to-weight engines and focused on heavy, high-speed interceptors like the MiG-25, which were poorly suited for low-speed turning dogfights.

items.title: 如何看待内存的涨价终于波及到了显卡，50 系显卡逐渐大面积缺货开始暴涨？
items.summary_zh: 内存涨价已传导至显卡领域，NVIDIA RTX 50系列显卡因显存成本上升、叠加AI与游戏需求旺盛，出现大面积缺货和价格暴涨。这暴露了供应链依赖单一内存厂商的风险，也让普通玩家和装机用户面临更大的预算压力。业内人士担忧，若内存持续高位，显卡价格短期内很难回落。
items.summary_en: The memory price hike has finally affected graphics cards: NVIDIA RTX 50 series GPUs are now suffering widespread shortages and sharp price increases due to rising VRAM costs combined with surging AI and gaming demand. This reveals the supply chain risk of relying on a few memory makers, and puts enormous pressure on ordinary PC builders and gamers. Industry insiders warn that if memory stays high, GPU prices are unlikely to drop anytime soon.

items.title: 英伟达与 SK 集团推出超 5000 亿美元双向交易 AI 合作计划，英伟达买内存，SK 买超算，如何解读？
items.summary_zh: 英伟达与SK集团宣布了一项超过5000亿美元的双向交易AI合作计划：英伟达购买SK的内存产品，SK购买英伟达的超算系统。这一大规模合作旨在稳固关键供应链、加速AI基础设施建设，同时凸显了计算与存储技术之间日益加深的相互依赖关系。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA and SK Group announced a landmark AI cooperation plan valued at over $500 billion, featuring a two-way trade: NVIDIA will purchase memory products from SK, while SK will acquire supercomputing systems from NVIDIA. The partnership is designed to secure critical supply chains and accelerate AI infrastructure development. It highlights the growing interdependence between AI compute and memory technologies, and is expected to have profound impacts on the global chip and memory markets.

items.title: 黄仁勋反对美国封禁中国 AI 模型，美方为什么要封禁？禁令真能落地吗？
items.summary_zh: 黄仁勋反对美国封禁中国AI模型，认为切断交流会阻碍全球创新。美方封禁主要出于国家安全担忧，担心中国AI技术被用于军事或监控。然而禁令能否落地存疑，因为AI模型本质上是软件，可通过开源社区、第三方服务器或代码片段传播，很难完全封锁。此外，许多中国AI成果基于公开论文，美企同样受益于全球合作。
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang opposes the U.S. ban on Chinese AI models, arguing that cutting off exchanges stifles global innovation. The U.S. cites national security, fearing Chinese AI could aid military or surveillance applications. But enforcing such a ban is highly questionable: AI models are software, easily shared via open-source platforms or third-party servers. Many Chinese advances build on publicly published research that also benefits American companies. A complete embargo seems impractical without harming U.S. interests.

items.title: 如何看待月之暗面发布 kimi K3-256K 大模型，能力和 K3 一样，不能看视频，上下文只有 256K？
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面发布了Kimi K3-256K大模型，能力与原有的K3相同，但上下文窗口限制为256K并取消了视频处理功能。这被视为在成本与性能之间的妥协，为不需要视频能力但需要长上下文的用户提供了一个更轻量化的选项，但也引发了社区关于为何不直接使用原版的讨论。
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI released the Kimi K3-256K large language model, which retains the same core capabilities as the original K3 but reduces the context window to 256K tokens and removes video processing support. This appears to be a cost-performance trade-off, offering a leaner alternative for users who need long-context handling but not multimodal video features. The move has sparked community debate about whether the stripped-down version is necessary when the full K3 already exists.

items.title: 一年赚走中国女人近5亿，曾被抛弃的性感巨头，重回第一
items.summary_zh: 曾因风格过于性感而被市场边缘化的某女性品牌，如今凭借精准的品牌重塑和产品升级，重新夺回行业第一宝座，一年内从中国女性消费者身上赚走近5亿元。它的逆袭故事展示了传统品牌如何在消费趋势变迁中灵活调整策略，抓住新一代女性的审美和需求红利，也印证了“性感”并非过时，而是需要与品质和情感共鸣结合。
items.summary_en: A once-dominant women's brand that was sidelined for being too sexy has staged a remarkable comeback, reclaiming the top spot in its industry and earning nearly 500 million yuan from Chinese female consumers in a single year. Through precise brand reinvention and product upgrades, it adapted to shifting consumer trends, capturing the aesthetic and emotional needs of a new generation. The story demonstrates that traditional brands can thrive by blending boldness with quality and resonance, proving that 'sexy' is far from outdated.

items.title: 8点1氪丨携程因滥用市场支配地位被罚没51.79亿元；长鑫科技今日上市；日本技术人员拆解宇树机器人：短期内赶不上中国
items.summary_zh: 今日三则重磅消息：携程因滥用市场支配地位被市场监管总局罚没共计51.79亿元，成为反垄断领域又一标志性案件；国产存储芯片巨头长鑫科技正式上市，标志着中国半导体产业在DRAM领域取得关键突破；日本技术人员拆解宇树科技的四足机器人后感叹，中国在机器人硬件集成和成本控制方面已建立起短期难以追赶的优势。这三条新闻分别从反垄断、芯片自主和机器人竞争角度反映了中国科技产业的现状与挑战。
items.summary_en: Three major stories today: Ctrip was fined a total of 5.179 billion yuan by the market regulator for abusing its market dominance, marking another landmark antitrust case. Changxin Memory Technologies (CXMT), a domestic DRAM giant, officially went public, signifying a key breakthrough in China's semiconductor industry. Japanese engineers dissected Unitree's quadruped robot and admitted that China has built an advantage in hardware integration and cost control that is hard to match in the short term. Together, these stories reflect the current landscape and challenges in China's antitrust enforcement, chip self-sufficiency, and robotics competition.

items.title: 存储的“下一个富矿”，突然不香了？
items.summary_zh: 曾被视为存储领域“下一个富矿”的去中心化存储或新型存储技术，近期却因技术落地缓慢、成本居高不下以及市场需求分化而突然降温。原本期待它颠覆传统云存储的投资者和开发者开始重新审视，而行业头部厂商的保守态度也让这一赛道变得不再吸引人。对于普通用户而言，这意味着短期内依然难以享受到更廉价、更私密的存储方案。
items.summary_en: What was once hailed as the next goldmine in storage—decentralized storage or emerging storage technologies—has suddenly lost its luster. Slow technical deployment, persistently high costs, and fragmented demand have cooled investor enthusiasm. Major vendors remain cautious, making the sector less attractive. For average users, this means cheap and private storage alternatives are still far off.

items.title: 51.79亿，携程挨了最重的罚
items.summary_zh: 携程因滥用市场支配地位被处以51.79亿元的巨额罚款，创下在线旅游平台反垄断罚单的新纪录。调查显示其存在捆绑销售、“二选一”等不正当竞争行为，严重损害了消费者和商户利益。此次重罚不仅震动行业，也向所有平台经济参与者发出强烈信号：监管铁拳不会停歇，合规经营才是长久之道。
items.summary_en: Ctrip, China's leading online travel agency, was fined a record 5.179 billion yuan for abusing its market dominance. The investigation uncovered practices like bundling and forced exclusivity deals that harmed consumers and merchants. This massive penalty sends a clear warning to all platform companies: antitrust enforcement remains aggressive, and compliance is essential for survival.

items.title: 蜜雪“雷霆大袋”炸街！网友：消费50元背出2万元排面
items.summary_zh: 蜜雪冰城推出的“雷霆大袋”因其巨大的容量和超低价格迅速走红，仅需50元就能背出价值两万元的视觉排面。这款超大包装袋不仅是实用的购物工具，更成为年轻人街头的新时尚单品。它完美抓住了消费者追求性价比和社交分享的心理，让品牌在社交媒体上获得了海量免费曝光。
items.summary_en: Mixue Bingcheng's 'Thunder Big Bag' has gone viral for offering massive capacity at just 50 yuan, giving buyers the appearance of carrying a 20,000-yuan luxury bag. It’s not just a practical shopping bag but a trendy street accessory. By tapping into the psychology of value-for-money and social sharing, the brand has generated massive free buzz on social media.

items.title: 全世界AI能力下降一万倍，只有我还是普通人
items.summary_zh: 在一个荒诞的假设场景中，全球所有人工智能的能力突然退化到一万年前的水平，唯独“我”保持了普通人的智力。于是，这个平时毫不起眼的普通人反而成为了世界上最聪明的存在，能轻松解决AI束手无策的问题。故事以黑色幽默的方式反思了人类对AI过度依赖的现状，以及普通人类智能的真正价值。
items.summary_en: In a satirical thought experiment, all AI in the world suddenly loses 99.99% of its capability, leaving an ordinary human as the smartest being on the planet. The story humorously critiques our overreliance on AI and highlights the underestimated value of baseline human intelligence—when everything else fails, a normal mind becomes extraordinary.

items.title: 顶流明星缺席LV上海秀，“LV诉讼”舆情出现转折点？
items.summary_zh: 原定出席LV上海大秀的顶流明星因法律纠纷临时缺席，这场缺席意外成为舆论焦点，甚至让LV涉嫌的诉讼案舆情出现微妙转折。公众的关注点从品牌本身的争议转向了艺人缺席背后的法律博弈，LV暂时获得了喘息之机。但转折能否持久，还要看后续诉讼进展和品牌危机公关的应对能力。
items.summary_en: A top celebrity unexpectedly pulled out of Louis Vuitton's Shanghai fashion show due to a legal dispute, shifting public attention away from the brand's own lawsuit controversies. The absence created a curious twist in the narrative: now the legal battle involving the star dominates headlines, giving LV a temporary reprieve. Whether this turning point lasts depends on how the litigation and PR crisis unfold.

items.title: OpenAI挖到最新菲尔兹奖得主，字节刚出炉的科学家计划在瞄准谁？
items.summary_zh: OpenAI最近招揽了一位刚刚获得菲尔兹奖的数学家，这标志着人工智能公司与顶尖数学人才之间的合作进入了新阶段。与此同时，字节跳动也在积极推进其科学家计划，试图吸引更多顶级科研人员加入。这些动向表明，科技巨头正在从传统学术圈抢人，以强化AI基础研究能力，未来竞争将更加依赖跨学科人才。
items.summary_en: OpenAI has hired a recent Fields Medal winner, highlighting the growing intersection between top-tier mathematics and artificial intelligence. Meanwhile, ByteDance is also rolling out its scientist recruitment program, aiming to attract leading researchers. These moves signal that tech giants are aggressively poaching talent from academia to bolster their fundamental AI research, making interdisciplinary expertise a key battleground in the industry.

items.title: “手搓一下”价格翻十倍，想解压的年轻人快玩不起手工了
items.summary_zh: 当下年轻人流行通过手工制作来解压，但手工材料包的价格却悄悄涨了十倍，比如简单的编织或泥塑现在动辄几百元。这种“手搓一下”的爱好原本是廉价放松方式，如今却因为市场热度过高、商家炒作以及材料成本上升，变得让很多年轻人直呼玩不起，解压经济正在催生新的消费压力。
items.summary_en: Young people are flocking to DIY crafts as a stress-relief hobby, but the cost of these kits has skyrocketed—some items now cost ten times what they did before. What was once an affordable way to unwind has become a luxury due to hype, rising material prices, and commercial speculation. This trend in the stress-relief economy is ironically adding financial pressure to those seeking relaxation.

items.title: Karpathy从Anthropic离职了？个人简介修改引发全网猜测
items.summary_zh: 知名AI研究者安德烈·卡帕西突然修改了自己的个人资料简介，删除了与Anthropic的关联信息，这立刻引发了全网关于他是否已从该公司离职的猜测。卡帕西曾在OpenAI和特斯拉担任要职，其动向一直备受关注，这次变动让外界对Anthropic的人才稳定性产生了新的疑问。
items.summary_en: Andrej Karpathy, a prominent AI researcher known for his work at OpenAI and Tesla, recently updated his personal bio to remove any mention of Anthropic, sparking widespread speculation about his departure from the company. The move has drawn attention to Anthropic's talent retention amid intense competition in the AI field, leaving the community guessing about Karpathy's next move.
